messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning a small routing tilt for EU edge nodes tonight 2026-04-10 22:00 UTC. Goal: nudge traffic to `eu-new` starting at 1% for 5m, then step to 12% steady. No infra deploys, just routing policy + DNS TTL tweak to 60s. Smoke plan below — ping if you can't make the window.

sam: I can take on-call for the window. Quick Q: rollback criteria? latency thresholds or error rates?

maya: Rollback triggers: sustained p95/p99 jump (>500ms p95 or p99 > 1s) OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m, OR model route 5xx spike. If triggered we flip weights back to `eu-old` and restore TTL. opsbot will run smoke probes.

joanne: I can run the smoke checklist. What's the exact dig/curl you want for sanity checks?

maya: For DNS check: `dig +short @8.8.8.8 eu-edge.example.net A` and `dig +noall +answer eu-edge.example.net` to confirm A records and TTL. For routing: curl header `X-Redwood-Route` from the edge LB & check `route_id`. Also check `/metrics/route_health` on each node.

liam: Adding a tiny poller for SLOs during the nudge: ```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
hosts=(eu1-edge eu2-edge eu3-edge)
for h in "${hosts[@]}"; do
  curl -s http://$h:9100/metrics | grep route_health || echo "no metrics from $h"
done
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled routing update queued for 2026-04-10T22:00:00Z by maya. Job ID r-218765.

sam: We should lower TTL to 60s ~30m before the tilt. I'll schedule TTL change at 21:30 UTC.

maya: Confirmed — TTL change at 21:30 UTC. opsbot will annotate runbook and mark the preflight checklist as complete.

joanne: Smoke checklist I'll run at 22:02 UTC (after 1% nudge):
1) Send 100 requests to `eu-new` and verify `X-Redwood-Route: eu-new` count > 0
2) p95 < 300ms for the sample set
3) No auth/logging errors; 502/503 count = 0
4) Token/unit cost within 10% of baseline
5) Confirm logs show requests routed to eu-new (sample ids posted)

liam: I'll watch the autoscalers and request queues. If anything on the infra side looks off I can flip weight back manually.

sam: Rollback commands for quick reference: `redwood route set-weight eu-new 0 --policy r-218765` and `redwood dns set-ttl eu-edge.example.net 300`. Notify infra-oncall after executing rollback.

joanne: Understood. I'll post results of the smoke run here and include the curl outputs. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks all — runbook link (internal): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/route-tilt-eu. If no red flags we'll proceed with the tilt as scheduled.

opsbot: Preflight checks passed. TTL lowered to 60s at 2026-04-10T21:30:05Z.

opsbot: Rollout started at 2026-04-10T22:00:10Z — stepping to 1% then monitoring.
